name: sample
note: ADR 0016 Shelf-B sample bundle exercising the prelude loader end-to-end. Two trivial Horn clauses defining the unary naturals as a compound term algebra: nat(z) and nat(s(X)) :- nat(X). These are ordinary account `Rule` nodes the EXISTING check() verifies (zero new trusted code). `program_digest` = lowercase-hex SHA-256(PROGRAM_PREFIX 'logos/account/program/v1\n' || concat of len-prefixed SORTED ontos-codec(quote(clause-as-term)) bytes), recomputed and verified by load_prelude. Each clause `id` = ClauseId::canonical (lowercase-hex SHA-256(CLAUSE_PREFIX || ontos-codec(quote(clause-as-term)))). Term notation as in vectors/account.json: term = {atom:<hex>}|{atom_str:<utf8>}|{tuple:[...]}|{var:<id>}; goal = {pred:<utf8>, args:[term...]}; negated body literal = {neg:<goal>}. The append/length list bundle is tracked separately (issue #240).
